analysis_steps.goal: Build resolved KS law and SFE maps at 43 pc

method.value: Regrid CO and 8 um PAH to 2.4" pixels; SFR surface density via log Sigma_SFR = 0.844 log Sigma_L8 - 30.923; inclination correction 70 deg; fit orthogonal distance regression

evidence.quote: The pixel size in our analysis is 2.4$''$ (or 43 pc, i.e. that of the 8 $\mu$m map).

Our surface density maps have been corrected by a fixed inclination of 70$^\circ$.

fitting.value: Gaussian mixture model (2 components, full covariance chosen by BIC) after removing 19 AGN points; orthogonal distance regression

evidence.quote: A Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) selects the best model, which is the one obtained with the full covariance matrix

validation.value: Compared fit with Boquien et al. 2011 calibration

evidence.quote: The two fits have a very similar slope but the (cite: 2011AJ....142..111B) intercept is slightly higher than the one we find.

limitations_admitted.value: Large scatter, projection effects and warped disk uncertainty in the KS fits; XCO uncertainty in CND

evidence.quote: We note however that the scatter is large

referee_caveats_inferred: CND SFE depends strongly on assumed XCO (5e20) and on 8 um PAH calibration near the AGN
Single fixed inclination of 70 deg for a warped disk

Hot AGN dust may contaminate the 8 um in the CND
